title: Favorite trumpeter Roy Eldridge and Dizzy Gillespie
summary: Roy Eldridge is his favorite trumpeter; he and his son debate Eldridge and Dizzy Gillespie.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Trumpeters I admired: rating the horn players

But up until today, my favorite trumpet player is Roy Eldridge. That's my favorite, you know? Because my son and I always have a big discussion about Roy Eldridge. He like Dizzy Gillespie, you know?
